title: HtmlAudio
responsibility: Renders the native audio element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlAudio.attributes
inputs.description: Native audio attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlAudio.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native audio element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlAudio
outputs.description: The actual native audio element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
